'''Zac'ryah Vos' airspeeder''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] used on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]] when Quinlan was disguised as his relative, General [[Zac'ryah Vos]]. Khaleen used the speeder to drop Vos off at [[Viento]]'s apartment, where Vos did battle with [[K'Kruhk]].
